title: [BUG] [duplicate] Non-Interactive Mode Fails to Authenticate Using Provided API Key
body:
Creating a new issue for visibility as I cannot reopen the old one. 🙂 

> I think this issue has resurfaced:
> 
> ```
> ~/dev/reproduce
> ➜ claude --version
> 0.2.90 (Claude Code)
> 
> ~/dev/reproduce
> ➜ claude -p "hello"
> Invalid API key · Please run /login
> ```
> 
> But when I start a session by calling `claude` it just picks up on my API key. 

 _Originally posted by @confususs in [#551](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/551#issuecomment-2838015126)_
author: confususs
